issue.body:
Part of #500 · Priority: P0 (Operation Stumply F-H1) · Spec: SPEC-0017 (design accepted; landing in #559)

## What

This is the event-enrichment half of F-H1. When the supervisor writes a run's SPEC-0014 envelope, it also runs the per-scheme extractor and stores a validated `typed{}` object. Templates then read `event.*` from `typed`, **never from the raw payload**.

- A new pure package, `internal/trigger/extract`. It holds one table per scheme, `{field, jsonPaths, validate}`:
  - `github`/`gitea`: `name` (the event header), `action`, `repo` (`repository.full_name`), `number` (`pull_request.number` → `issue.number` → `number`), `url` (`html_url`; its host must equal the repository's host), `sha` (`pull_request.head.sha` → `after`).
  - `gitlab`: the equivalents (`object_attributes.*`, `project.path_with_namespace`, 2–20 segments).
  - `channel`: `meta.<key>` for keys `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$` with ID-shaped string values. This covers Switchboard's `meta.todo_id` and `meta.queue`.
  - `bearer`, `hmac-sha256` and `standard-webhooks` (#466): opaque, so only envelope fields apply. `name` comes from the envelope's `webhook.event`.
- Validation patterns exactly as SPEC-0017 design § "Validation patterns". A value that is missing, of the wrong JSON type, or invalid is **absent**. It is never truncated, normalized or passed through raw. **No typed value may begin with `-`.**
- Envelope fields: `event.file`, `event.id` (the delivery ID only if ID-shaped, else daemon-generated), `event.kind`, `event.source`, `event.received_at`.
- `harness trigger --event` replays **re-extract** from the stored body. A hand-edited `typed` in a replay file is ignored.
- The envelope `version` stays `1` (`typed` is additive).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] REQ-8 scenarios: "A Gitea pull request", "A URL on another host", "A number that is a string", "A value starting with a dash", "Opaque sources".
- [ ] A property test (`testing/quick`) over arbitrary JSON payloads asserts that no extracted value begins with `-` and that every value matches its pattern. A mutation check shows the test fails if one pattern is loosened.
- [ ] Fixtures are **real captured deliveries** for GitHub, Gitea and GitLab `pull_request`/`issues`/`push`/`issue_comment`, and a Switchboard doorbell.
- [ ] REQ-7: "Required event field on a scheduled harness" (a load error), "Optional event field on a scheduled firing".
- [ ] REQ-11: "Unresolved required value" (a `push` has no number → `skipped` / `template_unresolved`).
- [ ] A replayed file whose `typed.repo` was edited renders the re-extracted value.

## Files likely to change

`internal/trigger/extract/` (new), the supervisor's envelope writer (from #456), `internal/supervisor/spawn.go` (the render context), `internal/config/config.go` (event path allow-sets).

## Dependencies

Depends on: stump.wtf/harness#456, stump.wtf/harness#462, stump.wtf/harness#466, stump.wtf/harness#471, stump.wtf/harness#501, stump.wtf/harness#503, stump.wtf/harness#504.

- #456 (the envelope and `HARNESS_EVENT_FILE`), #462 (forge verification), #471 (channel notifications), #466 (standard-webhooks).
- #501, #503 and #504 (the templating paths).

Sized **L**: parsing attacker-supplied payloads is security-critical, per the ladder's tie-breaker.

_Refreshed 2026-09-22 after the design review: design accepted (landing in #559); `Depends on:` normalized._

🤖 Posted on behalf of `@joestump` by [`claude-opus-5`](https://openrouter.ai/anthropic/claude-opus-5) using [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code).
